updates.content:
Title: Users may be unable to interact with the Microsoft 365 Copilot voice experience

User impact: Users may be unable to interact with the Microsoft 365 Copilot voice experience.

More info: Users can't use Copilot voice dictation or any of the voice experience.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft 365 Copilot and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users may be unable to interact with the Microsoft 365 Copilot voice experience

User impact: Users may be unable to interact with the Microsoft 365 Copilot voice experience.

More info: Users can't use Copilot voice dictation or any of the voice experience.

Current status: We have investigated the issue and determined that a new build is causing the affected experience. We are rolling back to a previous build to mitigate the issue.

Scope of impact: Users interacting with the Microsoft Copilot voice experience are impacted.

Next update by: Thursday, October 8, 2026, at 3:00 AM UTC

Title: Users may be unable to interact with the Microsoft 365 Copilot voice experience

User impact: Users may have been unable to interact with the Microsoft 365 Copilot voice experience.

More info: Users may have been unable to use Copilot voice dictation or other voice features.

Final status: We’ve determined that a recent service cleanup removed required feature configurations, resulting in connectivity issues with the Microsoft 365 Copilot voice experience. We restored the previous working build and confirmed that the issue is resolved.

Scope of impact: Users interacting with the Microsoft 365 Copilot voice experience may have been impacted.

Start time: Tuesday, October 6, 2026, at 3:00 PM UTC

End time: Wednesday, October 7, 2026, at 4:00 AM UTC

Root cause: A recent service cleanup removed required feature configurations, resulting in connectivity issues with the Microsoft 365 Copilot voice experience.

Next steps: - We’re reviewing our service cleanup  and validation procedures to better detect and prevent issues like this from occurring in the future.

This is the final update for the event.
